adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, the new fallback when a `credentialId` from a booking’s `_calendar` reference isn’t found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials` does `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` and then passes that credential to `getCalendar(...).deleteEvent(...)`. The DB lookup is only scoped by `id` (no `userId`/`teamId`/ownership check), so it can load and use any credential row matching that id, removing the prior implicit scoping to the booking owner’s known credentials and potentially enabling deletion using a credential not belonging to the booking owner/team.
